# Amber Lock — player files

Open [`index.html`](index.html) in any modern browser. No server, build step, or
internet connection is required to run it; you may use the web to research the
answers if you want to.

Twelve specimen locks each release one fragment of the archive index. The
fragments are **not** dispensed in reading order — each one carries an index
code. Recover all twelve, then arrange them in the assembly console by index and
run the decryption.

Answers are checked loosely: capitalization, punctuation, and common spelling
variants are accepted. Wrong answers stay vague; the explanation only appears
once a lock is solved.

Progress is saved in your browser's local storage. Use **Reset terminal** to
start over.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | The complete self-contained challenge |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Hashes of the player files |
